scalars.scalar_value: Large business or healthcare experience with cash disbursement processing, including check, credit card, wire transfers and EFT disbursements.
Experience with analyzing financial processes, policies and procedures.

items.item_text: Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.

Seven (7) years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus three (3) years of related experience/training. Relevant Experience: Experience with Financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and reconciliation.
Experience with analyzing financial processes, policies and procedures.
Large business or healthcare experience with cash disbursement processing, including check, credit card, wire transfers and EFT disbursements.

The position involves the processing and servicing of a variety of financial transactions, primarily cash disbursements and accounts payable, as well as the preparation of various financial analyses, reviews of financial data and account reconciliations. It includes preparation and processing of weekly cash disbursements, including check, credit card, ETF and wire transfer disbursements; and requires a working knowledge of related financial processes, policies and procedures.

The incumbent will have strong experience with vendor disbursements and electronic banking, and experience interacting with other finance and operational departments. They will work with members of various departments to resolve a wide range of relevant issues, and demonstrate sound judgement in selecting methods and techniques for resolution. Accordingly, this requires an individual with strong interpersonal skills, a service orientation, active listening skills and the ability to function effectively as a team member.

This position may also require preparation of various financial schedules or reports to meet internal and external reporting requirements, and may include activities relating to developing, implementing and monitoring accounts payable systems, policies and procedures.The position requires an individual with very strong attention to detail, good organizational skills, the ability to multi-task in a high-volume environment and the aptitude to apply sound judgment in the decision-making process.
Strong proficiency in the use of spreadsheet and database software.
Thorough knowledge of financial data management and reporting systems.

Strong interpersonal skills, analytical skills, service orientation, active listening, critical thinking, attention to detail, ability to multi-task in a high volume environment, organizational skills, effective verbal and written communication skills, sound judgment and decision making; ability to develop original ideas to solve problems.
Strong attention to detail, and ability to adhere to timelines.
Ability to function effectively as a member of a team.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities.
Thorough knowledge and understanding of internal control practices and their impact on protecting University resources.
Leadership skills to provide guidance, coaching and mentoring to professional and support staff.
